name: Chess Tutor
description: A friendly, complete chess teacher for kids: illustrated lessons, checkmate puzzles, a daily challenge, and games against 12 friendly animal & dinosaur characters on a genuine difficulty ladder — from a nearly-random penguin up to a strong club-level 'Machine' — who cheer, react, and coach as you play. Earn XP, badges, and ranks. Works fully offline; progress is saved in the note.
